      TRY(DATE_PARSE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(data_inicio_atividade AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '%d/%m/%Y'))
    ) AS di FROM vw_empresas WHERE 1=1

panels.description: Empresas com situação ativa a mais de 5 anos, sem restrições.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(DATE_PARSE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(data_inicio_atividade AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '%Y-%m-%d')),
      TRY(DATE_PARSE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(data_inicio_atividade AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '%d/%m/%Y'))
    ) AS di
  FROM vw_empresas
  WHERE 1=1
    AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
    AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
    AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(
  CASE
    WHEN UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO')
     AND di IS NOT NULL
     AND di <= current_date - INTERVAL '5' YEAR
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
) AS BIGINT) AS n
FROM x

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct FROM vw_empresas WHERE 1=1 
  AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
  AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
  AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(cnpj_formatado AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '') AS cnpj_formatado,
    NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(razao_social AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '') AS razao_social,
    UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) AS uf,
    NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(municipio AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '') AS municipio,
    NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '') AS porte,
    NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(ddd_telefone_1 AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '') AS telefone_raw
  FROM vw_empresas
  WHERE 1=1
    AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
    AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
    AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')
    AND cnpj_formatado IS NOT NULL
    AND razao_social IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(telefone_raw, '[^0-9]', '') AS telefone_digits,
    CASE
      WHEN uf IS NOT NULL
       AND REGEXP_LIKE(uf, '^[A-Z]{2}$')
       AND municipio IS NOT NULL
       AND LENGTH(TRIM(municipio)) >= 3
       AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(municipio), '^[0-9]+$')
      THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS cadastro_ruim
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  cnpj_formatado,
  razao_social,
  uf,
  municipio,
  porte,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(telefone_digits) = 11 THEN
      CONCAT(
        '(', SUBSTR(telefone_digits, 1, 2), ') ',
        SUBSTR(telefone_digits, 3, 5), '-',
        SUBSTR(telefone_digits, 8, 4)
      )
    WHEN LENGTH(telefone_digits) = 10 THEN
      CONCAT(
        '(', SUBSTR(telefone_digits, 1, 2), ') ',
        SUBSTR(telefone_digits, 3, 4), '-',
        SUBSTR(telefone_digits, 7, 4)
      )
    ELSE telefone_raw
  END AS telefone_principal
FROM scored
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN telefone_raw IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(telefone_raw) <> '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
  cadastro_ruim ASC,
  uf ASC,
  municipio ASC,
  razao_social ASC
LIMIT 500

panels.description: Lista CNAEs com maior taxa de empresas maduras e saudáveis (+ 5 anos, ativas e sem restrições)

targets.rawSQL:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    cnae_fiscal,
    atividade_economica,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(DATE_PARSE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(data_inicio_atividade AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '%Y-%m-%d')),
      TRY(DATE_PARSE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(data_inicio_atividade AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '%d/%m/%Y'))
    ) AS di
  FROM vw_empresas
  WHERE 1=1
    AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
    AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
    AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    substr(
      regexp_replace(
        NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(cnae_fiscal AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''),
        '[^0-9]', ''
      ),
      1, 7
    ) AS cnae,
    NULLIF(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(atividade_economica AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''),
      ''
    ) AS atividade,
    CASE WHEN di <= current_date - INTERVAL '5' YEAR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS madura
  FROM raw
  WHERE UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO')
    AND NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(cnae_fiscal AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '') IS NOT NULL
),
rotulado AS (
  SELECT
    cnae,
    COALESCE(atividade, cnae) AS nome,
    madura
  FROM base
  WHERE LENGTH(cnae) = 7
)
SELECT
  nome,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS volume,
  100.0 * CAST(SUM(madura) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_maduras
FROM rotulado
WHERE nome IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(nome) <> ''
  AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(nome), '^[0-9]+$')
GROUP BY nome
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 7

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') AS uf,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS total,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(ceis_sancionado AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) = 'TRUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS ceis_qtd,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(ceis_sancionado AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) = 'TRUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ceis_pct
FROM vw_empresas WHERE UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO') 
  AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
  AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')

GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15 ORDER BY ceis_pct DESC LIMIT 3
